description: Frozen benchmark goals for INTEL_ENGINE A/B evaluation (roadmap chapter 9). Do not edit goals between comparison runs; bump version instead. v2 adds multi-topic goals so depth-quota coverage completeness is non-trivial to satisfy.

protocol.notes: Same budget per engine. Metrics derive from persisted blackboards; precision additionally needs manual spot-check (50 items/config, two annotators) plus an LLM judge from a different provider than the collection model.
